description: Length of the Quillstone retirement window for the v1 orders endpoints; the shipments notice is a separate page. DISTILL-CANARY-18e5a3b9

web_fixture.title: v1 orders endpoints retirement - Quillstone
web_fixture.snippet: The v1 orders endpoints keep accepting requests for 120 days after the retirement notice.
web_fixture.content:
# v1 orders endpoints retirement

Quillstone notices, published 2026-02-17.

The v1 orders endpoints are retired. This notice opens a 120-day window: the
endpoints keep accepting requests for 120 days after the notice, and every
response during the window carries a Sunset header. Once the window closes,
calls to /v1/orders return 410 Gone.

Use /v2/orders for new integrations; the request body is unchanged.
